patterns.name: Injected client
patterns.rule: Feature clients accept HttpClient in their constructor.

patterns.name: Barrel export
patterns.rule: Each package exports its client and public interfaces from src/index.ts.

patterns.name: Shared response/error handling
patterns.rule: Transport and error transformation live in core.

patterns.name: Request/response interface split
patterns.rule: Feature interfaces are grouped under interfaces/requests and responses.

patterns.name: Workspace release
patterns.rule: Each package owns tsup build and prepublish scripts.
